domain: History and philosophy of specific fields
questions: What is a paradigm?
When the paradigm shifts, does everything old disappear?
What counts as an experiment?
If an experiment works once, has it proved the point?
What is a translation?
When a translation is finished, is the meaning unchanged?
Who decides the canon?
Once something enters the canon, does that settle what it means?
What does genealogy trace?
If a genealogy reaches an ancestor, has it found the origin?
What is a crisis?
When a crisis passes, do things return to normal?
What is reception?
If the reception is poor, does the message fail to get through?
What is a school?
When a school closes, do its ideas stop spreading?
What is memory?
If the memory is lost, is the past gone too?
What is a revolution?
After a revolution succeeds, does the old order disappear?
What is an archive?
If an archive is deleted, is everything in it gone?
What is an edition?
When a new edition appears, does the earlier edition stop mattering?
What is a model?
If a model fits perfectly, has it explained what is going on?
What is a standard?
Once a standard is adopted, does everyone measure the same thing?
What is a proof?
If a proof has a gap, does the result disappear?
